instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: How is cyclomatic complexity computed from a flow graph?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُحسب التعقيد الدوري من مخطط التدفق؟
options: edges minus nodes plus twice the components
edges minus nodes plus components here
nodes minus edges plus twice the components
edges plus nodes minus components now too
options_ar: الأضلاع ناقص العقد زائد ضعف المكوّنات
العقد ناقص الأضلاع زائد ضعف المكوّنات
options_en: edges minus nodes plus twice the components
edges minus nodes plus components here
nodes minus edges plus twice the components
edges plus nodes minus components now too
questions.explanation: For a graph with E edges, N nodes and P components, complexity is E minus N plus 2P.
questions.explanation_ar: لمخطط بحدود E وعقد N ومكوّنات P، التعقيد هو E ناقص N زائد 2P.

questions.question: Who introduced cyclomatic complexity?
options: B. Littlewood
T. J. McCabe
M. Halstead
B. Boehm here
options_en: B. Littlewood
T. J. McCabe
M. Halstead
B. Boehm here
questions.explanation: McCabe proposed the measure as a count of the independent paths through a program.
questions.explanation_ar: مكيب قدّم المقياس كعدّ للمسارات المستقلة داخل البرنامج.

questions.question: What does cyclomatic complexity actually count?
options: modules in the system too now too
variables in scope here again again
independent paths through the code
lines of code written now here
options_en: modules in the system too now too
variables in scope here again again
independent paths through the code
lines of code written now here
questions.explanation: It counts the basis set of independent paths, which sets the minimum test count.
questions.explanation_ar: يعدّ مجموعة المسارات المستقلة الأساسية، وهي التي تحدد الحد الأدنى للاختبارات.

questions.question: What does essential complexity measure?
options: the raw line count here again too now here too now here
the number of comments too now again again again
the compiler warnings now here here too now here
complexity left after removing structured constructs
options_ar: عدد الأسطر الخام أيضاً الآن هنا أيضاً الآن
عدد التعليقات هنا مجدداً أيضاً الآن هنا
تحذيرات المترجم الآن هنا مجدداً مجدداً
التعقيد المتبقي بعد إزالة التراكيب المنظمة
options_en: the raw line count here again too now here too now here
the number of comments too now again again again
the compiler warnings now here here too now here
complexity left after removing structured constructs
questions.explanation: Essential complexity isolates the irreducible decision structure of the program.
questions.explanation_ar: التعقيد الجوهري يعزل بنية القرار غير القابلة للاختزال.

questions.question: What does knot count measure?
options: crossings of control flow lines
the number of loops here again
the number of functions too
the depth of recursion now here
options_en: crossings of control flow lines
the number of loops here again
the number of functions too
the depth of recursion now here
questions.explanation: A knot is a crossing of flow lines in the graph, which signals tangled control.
questions.explanation_ar: العقدة تقاطع لخطوط التدفق في المخطط، وهي تدل على تحكم متشابك.

questions.question: What does nesting depth measure?
options: the number of modules now here
how deeply decisions are embedded
the number of statements too now here
the size of the data here again
options_en: the number of modules now here
how deeply decisions are embedded
the number of statements too now here
the size of the data here again
questions.explanation: Deeply nested conditions are harder to follow and to test than flat ones.
questions.explanation_ar: الشروط المتعمقة أصعب في المتابعة والاختبار من المسطحة.

questions.question: How does complexity relate to testability?
options: complexity has no effect here now
complexity removes the need for tests
higher complexity needs more tests
higher complexity needs fewer tests
options_ar: التعقيد بلا أثر هنا الآن أيضاً
options_en: complexity has no effect here now
complexity removes the need for tests
higher complexity needs more tests
higher complexity needs fewer tests
questions.explanation: Each independent path must be exercised, so the path count sets the testing burden.
questions.explanation_ar: كل مسار مستقل يجب اختباره، فعدد المسارات يحدد عبء الاختبار.

questions.question: What does an edge represent in the flow graph?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يمثل الضلع في مخطط التدفق؟
options: a variable declaration here too now
a comment line here too now again
a module boundary now again here
a transfer of control between nodes
options_en: a variable declaration here too now
a comment line here too now again
a module boundary now again here
a transfer of control between nodes
questions.explanation: Edges are control transfers; nodes are the statements or decision points.
questions.explanation_ar: الأضلاع انتقالات تحكم، والعقد هي العبارات أو نقاط القرار.
